locations.rationale: The explicit product.label call invokes the label method created by alias_method from this declaration.
The unqualified label call in Product#summary resolves to the label method created by this alias declaration.

records.rationale: The alias_method declaration creates Product#label as an alias of Product#name. The complete fixture has exactly two identifier calls resolving to that alias: product.label and the implicit-self label call in summary.
